test_title: PYST 44: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: Initial value of a car is Rs. 500000. The value of car depreciated by 10 percent of its initial value each year. What will be its value after 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Initial value of the car = Rs. 500000

Depreciation rate per year = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Value after n years = Initial value × (1 - Depreciation rate)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Depreciation rate = 10% = 0.10

Value after 3 years = Initial value × (1 - 0.10)³

⇒ Value after 3 years = 500000 × 0.90³

⇒ Value after 3 years = 500000 × 0.729

⇒ Value after 3 years = 364500

**The value of the car after 3 years is Rs. 364500.**
